answer: Superlinear slashing matrices bind each validator's stake C to a convex penalty f(C)=alpha*C^beta (beta>1) so any Sybil coalition of k agents incurs loss k*alpha*(C/k)^beta > C. Thus the protocol reaches a perfect Nash equilibrium where honest participation forms an oasis of stability and the attack surface collapses like a marble under compressive stress.
